preconditions.expression: T == int(T) and T >= 1 and T <= 40
preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 40 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(N) and K == int(K) and N >= 1 and K >= 1 for N, K in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, N and K are integers where 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^4 and 1 ≤ K ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(len(g) == N and all(1 <= int(x) <= K for x in g) for g in (line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly N integers, each between 1 and K inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((int(g[0]) ^ int(g[1]) ^ ... ^ int(g[N-1])) == max_possible_xor for g in (line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the XOR of the output integers equals the maximum possible XOR achievable under the constraints.
